thread_text:
sam: Heads-up — prepping release notes for v2.3.1 (runtime + API). Target change window Thu 23:00 UTC. Need internal announce blurb, deploybot commands, and pin info. We're pinning runtime to rif-runtime@3c7f. Any blockers?

nina: I can draft the internal announcement copy and pin text. Will post a draft link here EOD.

lee: Canary suggestion: 10% for 30m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 2% (5m) or p95 latency +100ms. Also watch for OOM spikes.

juan: +1. Add OOM_count > 0 as immediate rollback trigger. That’s usually the fastest indicator of bad quant changes.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: v2.3.1 canary window set for 2024-11-02T23:00:00Z. Command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --duration=30m` — confirm by :thumbsup:.

amy: Draft blurb suggestion: "We're shipping v2.3.1: improved KV-cache handling and ~10-15% token cost reduction for streaming chat. Canary tonight with guarded rollout. Oncall: @lee @juan. In case of issues run /rollback v2.3.1 and ping #eng-oncall."

nina: Nice. Two tweaks: add the runtime pin line and explicit fallback. Proposed sentence: "Pinned runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f (quantized). Fallback runtime: rif-quant-v2."

sam: Also include Dedicated customer note: "If you run on Dedicated, set header `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f` to pin. We will provide a migration window."

lee: Rollback playbook (short): 1) Pause deploybot; 2) Route traffic back to v2.3.0; 3) Notify impacted customers + CSM; 4) Collect logs & mark incident; 5) Postmortem sample. Keep it in the RN.

opsbot: Saved rollback automation rules: error_rate > 2% (window=5m), latency_p95_delta > 100ms (window=5m), oom_count > 0 (window=3m). Automated rollback will attempt if two rules fire concurrently.

juan: Who's owner for the internal blast? Nina or Sam?

nina: I'll own the internal blast + pushing pin in the console. Will put a draft in #eng-releases for a quick 10:30 UTC review pass.

sam: Thanks. Add a one-line ops checklist in the RN with exact runbook commands we expect oncall to use (copy-paste friendly).

amy: Ops snippet suggestion to include: ```bash
# Pause canary
deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}
# Rollback to previous
deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0
```

lee: Also add the observability query in the RN: `Query: service:runtime errors{env:prod} | rate(5m)` and `Query: service:runtime latency_p95{env:prod}` so reviewers can quickly check.

nina: Note about customer timing: we should avoid blasting customer-facing notes during 00:00-06:00 UTC. I'll schedule internal announce at 22:45 UTC so ops have ~75m to eyeball pre-window.

deploybot: Reminder: deploybot enforces blackout windows. If scheduled outside allowed window, deploy will fail and require manual override.

lee: For safety, pin fallback model variant in the RN to `rif-quant-v2` and mention that automatic fallback will be enabled for retries.

nina: Draft posted: https://rwd.internal/docs/releases/v2.3.1-draft — please review. I'll merge and post internal announce at 22:45 UTC if no objections.

sam: Quick smoke locally now. If I see anything odd I'll flag here. Otherwise :thumbsup: and thanks everyone.

amy: LGTM — added a one-line customer-heads-up note in the draft.

juan: All good from my side. I'll be oncall during the window.

deploybot: Canary started (10%) -> monitoring hooks active. Good luck! :rocket:
